name: Harmonic Drive Systems Inc.
blurb: Harmonic Drive Systems Inc. designs, manufactures, and sells precision reduction gears and actuators used in industrial robots, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, and aerospace applications. The company is a global leader in harmonic drive gearing technology, holding a strong market position in robotics and automation. Its products are critical for high-precision motion control in various industries.
recent: In the past 30 days, Harmonic Drive Systems shares surged 35% as of October 9, 2025, reflecting investor optimism about its prospects. The stock's price-to-sales ratio of 5.8x is significantly higher than the industry average, indicating high growth expectations. Despite a 7.8% revenue decline over the past three years, recent revenue growth of 4.4% year-over-year has bolstered sentiment.
